Rust has no exceptions. Recoverable errors are values of the Result type, either Ok with a value or Err with an error, and the question mark operator returns early on Err, converting the error with the From trait. Option covers values that may be absent. Panics are for bugs, not for expected failures like a missing file. Libraries usually define their own error enum, often with the thiserror crate, while applications use anyhow to attach context. Like borrowing in [[Rust ownership]], this makes failure paths visible in the types.
